purpose: Form RSC-3 is used by the Tribunal to give notice to the creditors of the company, seeking their representations and objections regarding the reduction of share capital.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within seven days of the direction given by the Tribunal or such other period as directed
steps: The Tribunal gives notice to the creditors of the company in Form No. RSC-3.
The notice is sent to each creditor whose name is entered in the list of creditors submitted by the company.
The notice informs creditors about the presentation of the application and the list of creditors.
Creditors may send their representations and objections within the time specified by the Tribunal.
checklist: List of creditors submitted by the company
Details of the amount of the proposed reduction of share capital
Amount or estimated value of the debt, contingent debt, or claim for each creditor
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
